verses.en: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.sm: Lemueli le tupu, o le valoaga na aʻoaʻoina ai o ia e lona tina.

verses.en: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.sm: Se a ea sa'u upu ia te oe laʻu tama e? se a lava sa‘u upu ia te oe na fanau i loʻu manava? se a lava sa‘u upu ia te oe le tama na ou tauto ai?

verses.en: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.sm: Aua ne“ e avatu lou malosi i fafine, ma ou ala i le mea e fano ai tupu.

verses.en: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.sm: Lemueli e, e le ono i tupu, e le ono lava i tupu le inu uaina, po o alii e manao i le ‘ava;

verses.en: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.sm: ina ne“ inu o ia, ona galo ai lea o tulafono, ma faasese le finauga o se tasi tagata ua tigaina.

verses.en: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.sm: Avatu le ‘ava i lē a mole; ma le uaina i le ua tiga le loto;

verses.en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.sm: ia inuai o ia, ma faagalogalo i lona mativa; ma ia le toe manatu i lona puapuaga.

verses.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.sm: Ia e tautala mo e gúgú, o le finauga lava o i latou uma ua aumatua;

verses.en: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.sm: ia e tautala ia faamasino ma le tonu, ma ia finau mo e ua puapuagatia, ma e ua mativa.

verses.en: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
verses.sm: to O le aya amio lelei, o ai ea se ua maua?

verses.en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.sm: e silisili lona tau i penina. tt Ua faatuatua ia te ia le loto o lana tane; e le mativa o ia i oloa.

verses.en: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.sm: E agalelei o ia ia te ia, a e le agaleaga i aso uma o lona olaga.

verses.en: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.sm: Na te sailia fulufulu mamoe ma lino; ua galue ai ona lima ma le fiafia.

verses.en: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.sm: E tusa o ia ma vaa o le faatauoa; e mamao le mea e au mai ai ana mea e ‘ai.

verses.en: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.sm: E tulai foi o ia, ao po lava, ma avatu mea e ‘ai i lona aiga, ma le galuega ua tofia i ana auauna teine.

verses.en: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.sm: Ua manatunatu O ia i se fanua, ona maua ai lea e ia; o le fua o ona lava lima ua ia fai ai le tovine.

verses.en: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.sm: Na te fusia lona sulugatiti i le malosi; na te faamalosia ona lava lima.

verses.en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e ia ua lelei lana tau; e le mate lana lamepa i le po.

verses.en: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.sm: Ua tuu atu e ia ona lima i le kisuro, ma ua tago atu ona lima i le peleke.

verses.en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.sm: Ua faamafola lona lima i le ua tigaina; ua tuu atu foi ona lima i le ua mativa.

verses.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.sm: E le fefe o ia ona o lona aiga i le kiona; aua ua oofu lona aiga uma i ofu mtima.

verses.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
verses.sm: Ua fai ie afu mona; o le ie vavae ma le ie pauli, o ona ofu ia.

verses.en: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.sm: Ua iloga lana tane i faitotoa, pe a saofai o ia faatasi ma toeaina o le nuu.

verses.en: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.sm: Ua fai e ia le ofu lino, ma faatau ai; ua avatu foi fusi i le faatauoa.

verses.en: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.sm: O le malosi ma le mamalu e fai mona ofu ia; ua ‘ata‘ata foi o ia i aso O lumanai.

verses.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.sm: Ua tautala o ia ma le poto; ua i lona laulaufaiva le tulafono o le alofa.

verses.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.sm: Ua vaavaai o ia i amioga a lona aiga; e le ‘ai foi o ia mea e “ai a le paie.

verses.en: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verses.sm: E tulai mai lana fanau, ma faafetai ia te ia; o lana tane foi ua vivii ia te ia.

verses.en: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
verses.sm: E toatele fafine e amio lelei i latou; a o oe, ua faasilisili oe ia i latou uma.

verses.en: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.sm: O le matagofie e pepelo lea, o le mea faatauvaa le lalelei; a o le fafine ua mata'u i le ALII, e viia lava o ia.

verses.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.sm: Avatu ia te ia le fua o ona lima; o ana galuega foi e viia ai o ia i faitotoa.
